dict.string: This app uses camera for QR code scanning and for KYC verification
This app uses location access to support features that depend on nearby services and secure account workflows.
This app uses Bluetooth to support nearby device and external SDK features when enabled.
This app uses contacts to support user-driven sharing and account-related features when needed.
Biometric verification is required to further secure your account.
This app uses Siri integration to support voice-driven actions when available.
This app uses Apple Music access only if a music-related feature or SDK requires it.
This app uses calendars to let you add or manage app-related reminders and scheduled events.
This app uses microphone access for audio capture and voice-related features when enabled.
Some features may require location access due to third-party services used by the app.
